name: 42240 · Hopkinsville, KY
findings: ZIP 42240 (Hopkinsville) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 33 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 42240 (Hopkinsville) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 42240 (Hopkinsville) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 45% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
